title: 20 Skills for a Complete Autonomous Software Factory
description: Taxonomy of agent skills converting LLM coders into an enterprise software delivery factory.

skills.name: spec-driven-development
skills.role: Turn product requirements into structured specifications, implementation plans, and verifiable deliverables.

skills.name: pipeline
skills.role: Orchestrate autonomous plan -> build -> review workflows with quality gates and isolated Git worktrees.

skills.name: ensemble-team
skills.role: Coordinate specialized AI agents for planning, implementation, testing, and code review.

skills.name: task-management
skills.role: Break complex features into manageable tasks with dependencies, ownership, and progress tracking.

skills.name: tdd
skills.role: Enforce test-driven development through automated red-green-refactor cycles.

skills.name: code-review
skills.role: Review AI-generated code for specification compliance, quality, and domain correctness.

skills.name: debugging-protocol
skills.role: Systematically investigate bugs, identify root causes, and validate fixes.

skills.name: ci-integration
skills.role: Integrate automated builds, tests, and quality gates into software delivery pipelines.

skills.name: mutation-testing
skills.role: Evaluate test effectiveness by introducing controlled code mutations.

skills.name: architecture-decisions
skills.role: Record technical tradeoffs and architectural decisions for consistent agent execution.

skills.name: domain-modeling
skills.role: Design robust domain models using type-driven design and explicit business invariants.

skills.name: event-modeling
skills.role: Model business workflows, system events, and acceptance scenarios before implementation.

skills.name: ticket-triage
skills.role: Evaluate issue readiness and turn ambiguous tickets into actionable engineering tasks.

skills.name: factory-review
skills.role: Review autonomous factory output with quality metrics, audit trails, and human approval.

skills.name: memory-protocol
skills.role: Preserve development knowledge and retrieve past context across agent sessions.

skills.name: bootstrap
skills.role: Initialize projects with agent instructions, environment detection, and development workflows.

skills.name: atomic-design
skills.role: Build consistent, reusable UI systems using component-based design principles.

skills.name: user-input-protocol
skills.role: Handle human clarification and approval requests without losing agent workflow state.

skills.name: spec-to-plan
skills.role: Convert approved specifications into actionable engineering plans for coding agents.

skills.name: agentic-code-review
skills.role: Create repeatable AI-powered code review loops with structured feedback and validation.
